svg.title: Status window: Shuvam Banerji Seal
svg.desc: Isekai-style status window. Class: Alchemist-Sage (computational chemistry × AI). Guild: IISER Kolkata, BS-MS chemistry major with computer-science minor. Titles: UIDAI Data Hackathon 2026 1st prize, MeitY GENESIS co-founder of two startups, Slashdot president, AAAI and ICWSM reviewer, FIRE 2026 track co-organizer. Stats: 3 papers plus 1 under review, 2 open datasets, 2 startups, 4 first places, 2000+ app users.
